query: SELECT seq FROM channel_messages c WHERE channel_id = $1 AND seq > $2 AND NOT (c.type = 'person_message' AND c.body->>'member' = '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i WHERE i.team_copy_channel = c.channel_id AND i.team_copy_seq = c.seq AND i.execution_status IN ('queued', 'delivered'))) ORDER BY seq LIMIT $3
